# netbox_virtual_machine_interface (Data Source)

Retrieves a single virtual machine interface from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_virtual_machine_interface" "example" {
  name               = "example"
  virtual_machine_id = 1
}

output "virtual_machine_interface_id" {
  value = data.netbox_virtual_machine_interface.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the virtual machine interface.

### Optional

- `virtual_machine_id` (Number) The ID of the virtual machine associated with the virtual machine interface.

### Read-Only

- `bridge_id` (Number) The ID of the bridge associated with the virtual machine interface.
- `count_fhrp_groups` (Number) The count fhrp groups of the virtual machine interface.
- `count_ipaddresses` (Number) The count ipaddresses of the virtual machine interface.
- `created` (String) When the virtual machine interface was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the virtual machine interface, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the virtual machine interface.
- `enabled` (Boolean) The enabled of the virtual machine interface.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `l2vpn_termination_id` (Number) The ID of the l2vpn termination associated with the virtual machine interface.
- `last_updated` (String) When the virtual machine interface was last changed.
- `mac_address` (String) The mac address of the virtual machine interface.
- `mac_addresses` (List of Number) The IDs of the mac addresses of the virtual machine interface.
- `mode` (String) The mode of the virtual machine interface.
- `mtu` (Number) The mtu of the virtual machine interface.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the virtual machine interface.
- `parent_id` (Number) The ID of the parent associated with the virtual machine interface.
- `primary_mac_address_id` (Number) The ID of the primary mac address associated with the virtual machine interface.
- `qinq_svlan_id` (Number) The ID of the qinq svlan associated with the virtual machine interface.
- `tagged_vlans` (List of Number) The IDs of the tagged vlans of the virtual machine interface.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `untagged_vlan_id` (Number) The ID of the untagged vlan associated with the virtual machine interface.
- `vlan_translation_policy_id` (Number) The ID of the vlan translation policy associated with the virtual machine interface.
- `vrf_id` (Number) The ID of the vrf associated with the virtual machine interface.
